newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS NAMES OOSTERVELD STRATEGY DIRECTOR.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS NAMES OOSTERVELD STRATEGY DIRECTOR.

text.p: Philips said on Thursday Jan Oosterveld would become senior director of corporate strategy, reporting to chairman Cor Boonstra.

Oosterveld, currently a managing director in the components division, will take up the post from May 1 with responsibility for ensuring Philips has a portfolio of alliances that supports the company's vision of itself.

"By appointing Mr. Oosterveld the company wants to emphasize the importance it attaches to a well-defined high volume electronics strategy, with particular attention to the new digital markets," Philips Electronics NV said in a statement.

The company said its corporate strategy operation supports the management board in developing the company's corporate vision in deciding on its business portfolio and in reviewing business and product division strategies.
Philips under Boonstra, who became chairman last October, has been reviewing its operations, shedding underperforming and non-core businesses.
A spokeswoman said the move showed the increasing importance Philips was placing on the development of its corporate strategy. "This is quite a heavyweight position," she said.

Oosterveld has worked for Philips since 1972, and will continue to be the main spokesman for DVD, the optical disc format which allows the storage of over four hours of studio quality video and audio.
